rows.name: data
rows.description: Data for the ODSLineChart. Similar to the data property provided by the Chartjs library.

rows.name: options
rows.description: Options for the ODSLineChart. Similar to the options property provided by the Chartjs library.

rows.name: showTooltip
rows.description: Show/Hide the ODS tooltip. Independent of the native Chart.js tooltip, which is controlled through options.plugins.tooltip.

rows.name: pointType
rows.description: Defines the style of the points.
